connect_in_terminal.description: Start sessions in a terminal so username, password or 2FA prompts can be answered. Enable this for profiles that are not certificate-only.
connect_in_terminal.label: Connect in a terminal

default_profile.description: Profile used by the bar widget and the control-center toggle. Empty means the first imported profile.
default_profile.label: Default profile

hide_when_disconnected.description: Remove the bar widget while no VPN session is active
hide_when_disconnected.label: Hide when disconnected

poll_interval.description: How often the session manager is polled, in seconds
poll_interval.label: Refresh interval

show_label.description: Show the active profile name next to the bar glyph
show_label.label: Show profile name

show_traffic.description: Include the session byte counters in the bar tooltip
show_traffic.label: Show traffic
